title: Gujarat HC Denies Anticipatory Bail to Bank Official for Reactivating Widow's Dormant Scheme Account
case_name: Yogendra Vijay Bahadur Singh v. State of Gujarat
card_summary: The Gujarat High Court denied anticipatory bail to a bank's former Cluster Sales Head accused of getting a widow's dormant state-scheme account reactivated by changing its registered mobile number, after which a co-accused withdrew the funds by ATM. The material on record prima facie linked him to the transaction; misuse of authority over customer money strikes at the trust a bank depends on.
card_tip: Banks should treat any employee-enabled change to a dormant or welfare-scheme account's registered contact details as a red flag calling for immediate internal audit, not just a customer-service request.
